### Install

1. Download the `.dmg` below, open it, and drag Peony to Applications. It runs on Apple silicon and Intel Macs with macOS 14 or later.
2. Open Peony. The app isn't notarized yet, so macOS blocks it the first time. Open **System Settings > Privacy & Security**, scroll down, and click **Open Anyway**.
3. Install the client your VPN needs, as the [README](https://github.com/PunGrumpy/peony#install) lists, then add your first VPN.

With Homebrew, `brew install --cask pungrumpy/tap/peony` does step 1 for you.

The `.zip` holds the same app, and `SHA256SUMS` lists checksums for both files.
